unsupported_prompt_obligations: The procedure says HR requests revocation from IT and requests a final-check calculation from Payroll; these are email requests, not proof that IT revoked access or Payroll sent a paycheck. HR explicitly does not process final pay.

Only named actionable queue rows are covered. Ambiguous/unknown PTO is reported in the Payroll request as stated by policy; full completion of every possible termination and any external system state is not established.
